items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 11:1
items.html: Just as the lower man, through good deeds, raises MAN to ZON, so ZON select from the posterior of Aba and Ima that fell to their place, and raise MAN to Aba and Ima. Likewise Aba and Ima do this above them, until the end of all the degrees, until the first, uppermost Partzuf draws Mochin from the light of Ein Sof, blessed be He, and brings them down to the one below it, and so they pass to ZON. Thus every raising of MAN by the righteous causes the light to descend anew from Ein Sof, blessed be He, Himself, for there is no renewal of light in any of the worlds that is not drawn from Ein Sof, blessed be He. Remember this. (p. 505, in Inner Light, Sub Header, “Caused”)
